Tournament.title: Tournament State
Tournament.description: Represents the complete state of a single tournament, including players, rounds, and pairings.

players.description: The list of all players in the tournament.

pairings.description: The pairings for the current round.

status.description: The current status of the tournament.

history.description: A record of the tournament state at the beginning of each round.

/tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Stores the state of a single tournament.
